prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a unique landscape editorial cover for a homeowner guide about setting up a home music library with Music Assistant. A close, tactile view of a small collection of vinyl records with blank unbranded cream and forest-green sleeves on an oak shelf in a warm lived-in residential listening nook. One black vinyl record partly out of its sleeve in the foreground gives an unmistakable music-library theme; in the softly focused background a forest-green armchair and an open doorway to a sunlit dining room suggest music enjoyed across the home. Natural morning side light, realistic wood grain and linen, restrained cream and dark-green Tara palette, professional magazine photography, composition readable at small card size, landscape 1536x1024. This is illustrative music-library context, not a photographed installation or product endorsement. Do not show any electronics, speakers, smart-home devices, invented hardware, screens, logos, text, album names, graphs, network lines, overlays, floating UI cards, translucent panels, inset frames or headline typography.
visual_review: PASS: warm oak music-library scene with cream record sleeves and forest-green seating; record remains clear at card size. No electronics, invented products, interface overlays, logos or testing claims. Illustrative cover, not a product photograph.
